title: Design System: Molis Work Coss Workbench

body.purpose: Readable explanations and Goal event paragraphs, normally held within 76ch.

settings-heading.purpose: Independent global/project preferences and planning headings use 20px/600/1.4 across desktop and narrow widths; desktop token is in DESIGN.md.

tab.purpose: Equal-width ordinary work tabs with colored icons; active weight 550. Pinned tabs show icons only. Titles retain their full accessible name.

shadows.name: surface-light
shadows.purpose: Shared shallow surface depth; current work tabs explicitly omit it.

shadows.name: control-light
shadows.value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent), 0 12px 32px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 12%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Retained menus and other dialogs; attached editors omit depth and compact search/confirmation surfaces use compact-dialog.

shadows.name: control-dark
shadows.purpose: Retained menus and other dialogs; attached editors omit depth and compact search/confirmation surfaces use compact-dialog.

shadows.name: expanded-goal
shadows.purpose: Goal work and records are flush to the pane, without inset, radius, shadow or canvas backdrop.

shadows.name: home-composer
shadows.purpose: A faint structural lift for the disabled home composer; the date and calendar remain flat.

shadows.name: compact-dialog
shadows.purpose: 8px compact search/confirmation surfaces; #00000026 backdrop, no blur. Attached temporary editors use no shadow and a 10% theme-ink backdrop.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Shared hover and focus feedback; removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: section-reveal
motion.purpose: Reveal the selected body in the 关联与约束 stage while selector cards remain stationary; removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: project-settings-disclosure
motion.purpose: Independent project preferences disclosure arrows and switch knobs. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

motion.name: surface-arrival
motion.purpose: Retained shared dialog arrival; attached editors use editor-opacity instead. Removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: feed-reader-reveal
motion.purpose: Inline reader arrives from opacity 0 and translateY(-3px); its chevron uses transform 160ms ease. Both are removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: editor-opacity
motion.purpose: Attached temporary editors fade without translation or scale; removed under reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: project-settings-categories
breakpoints.purpose: Project preferences replaces its 224px rail with four equal category links above the single content scroller; controls and navigation use 44px minimum targets.

breakpoints.name: pane-focus
breakpoints.purpose: Only the focused pane is visible; tabs are 144px wide and window selectors retain access to other panes.

breakpoints.name: directory-compact
breakpoints.purpose: Default directory width is 256px instead of 280px.

breakpoints.name: goal-rail-overlay-container
breakpoints.purpose: Goal-workspace container threshold for the information/timeline overlay.

breakpoints.name: feed-reader-actions
breakpoints.purpose: Two equal action columns with 44px minimum targets; body insets reduce and titles wrap.

breakpoints.name: attention-controls
breakpoints.purpose: At this maximum viewport width OR pointer:coarse, tabs/group labels and Close/Split use 44px targets; the final shared sheet scopes 44px control height to Frame picker/add actions and Home Goals/manual-quotation actions. Desktop fine-pointer dimensions remain compact.

breakpoints.name: attached-editor-full-width
breakpoints.purpose: New Goal, Feed tasks, Session add/relations and Frame picker fill viewport width. Above this width they use min(560px, 100vw); all begin at 44px and fill the remaining height.

narrative.overview:
Molis Work is a personal workbench for finding current work, reading its facts, and taking the next action. Its current visual language follows the user's Linear × coss.ui direction: continuous paper surfaces, thin boundaries, compact controls, distinct navigation levels, and short feedback. The quiet project home and denser Goal workspace belong to the same system.

This is the current built world as of 2026-09-16. [Coss workbench redesign](specs/coss-workbench-redesign/spec.md) establishes the shared foundation; [Workbench panes, Feed and global settings redesign](specs/workbench-pane-feed-redesign/spec.md) owns the current tabs, nested panes, Feed and global preferences. The independent project settings world follows [Project settings redesign](specs/project-settings-redesign/spec.md). [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md) remains the authority for product behavior, data relationships, and module ownership; this document records their current visual expression. The latest [whole-product interaction redesign](specs/product-interaction-redesign/spec.md) and its [surface inventory](specs/product-interaction-redesign/inventory.md) own the current form actions, Feed reader, Session entry, settings return context and Artifact empty states. Its v11 correction makes Goal work and records continuous with the pane and attaches temporary editors to the workspace edge. It retains v6 attention continuity and v7–v10 scrolling, reading and editing behavior. Detailed behavior, source ownership, motion and verification boundaries are in the [workbench surface record](.impeccable/surfaces/immersive-workbench.md).
keyCharacteristics: One directory for project identity, destinations, the active plugin list, shortcuts and device settings.
A 44px work bar with rounded equal-width tabs, compact pinned icons, stable plugin colors and a separate action area.
Neutral Light/Dark tokens shared by the workbench, settings and project index.
Independent global and project settings with category navigation and one content scroll boundary.
Compact navigation and continuous reading/work surfaces; temporary editors meet the workspace edge while preserving modal focus.
Real state and explicit actions; unavailable capabilities remain visibly unavailable.
Adjacent Cancel/Submit actions, scoped saves, single-title inline Feed reading and explicit empty states.
One viewport shell with stable toolbars and scrolling owned by lists, readers, boards and forms.
Current Goal facts before history, explicit Frame/work transitions and existing-content references stored only as local canvas state.
Pointer-aware board scrolling and retained keyboard focus.
Density v12: 12px field gaps, 88px minimum Feed rows, 920px settings column, desktop paired Session selectors; mobile 16px fields and 44px actions retained.
dos: **Do** build hierarchy from spacing, text and meaningful boundaries; use paper continuity for work and selected tabs, attached edges for temporary editors and restrained depth for compact prompts.
**Do** keep the current tab, loaded body, selected directory item and owned terminal consistent without copying domain state.
**Do** retain source links, exact Artifact versions and original record IDs; make current facts distinct from historical evidence.
**Do** preserve visible focus, keyboard paths, error recovery, responsive reading and reduced motion. Keep the shell within the viewport and scroll long content in its owning component.
**Do** state settings scope, keep global and project preferences independent and provide a direct return to prior work.
**Do** use the existing owner renderer and shared token source when adding screens.
**Do** keep Feed read state separate from destination state, read the body before processing, and disclose optional materials only when present.
**Do** pair form Cancel and Submit, label independently saved regions, preserve drafts on failure, and carry project context through global settings.
donts: **Don't** restore the old 32px work bar, underlined active work tab, 10px shared controls, or separate Settings palette.
**Don't** add a second persistent directory inside the workbench, decorative dashboard cards, duplicate mode bars or inactive placeholder tools.
**Don't** embed project preferences in workspace/plugin tabs or revive the asynchronous exclusive settings stage.
**Don't** turn a disabled composer, Session demo, reserved module or browser screenshot into a claim of an integrated feature.
**Don't** infer completion from child counts, activity or missing requirements, or treat UI selection as execution authority.
**Don't** make status color the only explanation, allow long paths to widen the viewport, or hide the current tab when resizing.
**Don't** use review screenshots as product imagery or claim browser review verifies the native package or every low-frequency form.
**Don't** repeat the Feed stage eyebrow, expanded title or summary, or ask users to select an Artifact when the project has no results.
